translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content: Israelia Babilonɨn kantrin kalabusɨn ikiavɨra ikia Jerusalemɨn nguibam bagha arai

content.text: E Babilonɨn Faner mɨriabar apiaghav ikiava,
Saionɨn nguibam gɨnɨghnɨgha
a bagha azia iti.
E uan gitabav sozir puvatɨ,
e purama da isa en boroghɨn itir temer aguabar da gui.
Gumazir e isa kalabus garɨghiziba ghaze,
“Ia ighiabar amu en navibar amutɨ da deraghtɨ e bar akuegham.
Ia Saionɨn nguibamɨn ziam dɨghor e bagh ighiabar amu.”
E manmagh suvɨra kantrin igharazimɨn ikɨ,
egh Ikiavɨra Itir Godɨn onger akabar amuam?
Kar en kantri puvatɨ,
e kamaghɨn damuan kogham.
O Jerusalemɨn Nguibam, kɨ nɨ gɨn amadagh,
gita inigh uan agharir guvimɨn uam a mɨsoghan kogham.
O Jerusalem, kɨ nɨ isa faraghavɨra uan dɨghorim gamigha nɨ bagha bar akonge.
Kɨ ua nɨ bakɨnɨghnɨgh nɨ isɨ uan nɨghnɨzim datɨghan koghtɨ,
nan tiarim ikuvightɨ kɨ ighiabar amuan kogham.
O Ikiavɨra Itir God, nɨ dughiar gumaziba Jerusalem gasɨghasɨzi, Idomia e gamizir arazim gɨnɨghnɨgh.
Me ivɨvɨgha ghaze,
Jerusalemɨn dɨpeniba bar dɨpɨrighiregh nguazim giregh.
O Babilonia, ia orakigh.
Ia bar ikuvigham!
Ian arazir kurar ia e gamizir kam,
gumazir uam a ikarvaghamim, a bar akongegh.
Gumazir kam nɨn borir iririviba inigh,
dagɨabav kɨnightɨ me bar ikuvigham.
Kamaghɨn, gumazir kam bar akuegham.
